caption: A page layout controls four zones at once: the highlights panel, the action buttons, and which tabs (Related, Details) even exist on the page.
Compact Layout Edit: pick up to 10 fields, in priority order — this is what shows in the highlights panel and on a phone, not the full record.
Hover an Account on an Opportunity and the compact layout's chosen fields — Type, Phone, Website, Account Owner — are exactly what appears.

code:
Page Layout:
  controls the FULL record page
  every field, section, related list, button

Compact Layout:
  controls the SUMMARY view
  highlights panel + mobile + hover cards
  max 10 fields, in priority order
caption: Confusing the two is the single most common Platform App Builder exam mistake.

subtitle: The drag-and-drop canvas behind every Lightning page.
